topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Sitting here in the gloom of this endlessly dripping evening, the last thing I expected to hear was a knock on my door, followed by the soft-spoken request to "borrow" a patch of my yard for a garden. This city's not exactly famous for its greens, and folks around here, they've got their reasons for asking, none of them likely to be as innocent as a little soil and some seeds. But there's something in the way the rain's hitting the pavement, a rhythm that's got me pondering. Maybe it’s a plea for a bit of life in the midst of this concrete jungle. Gotta admit, the idea’s got a certain appeal; a bit of nature versus the endless urban sprawl. Beats the alternative. I'll need to think on it.
